proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent-supplied proof of the selected node, S(ω) ≤ Λⁿ∫_{M_Y∩G} θ_Y dHⁿ = Λⁿμ_{RY}(G), passed to [0, ∞] with ofReal. It is written here for a general bounded integrand. The estimate is the integral form of Simon's mass bound M_W(f_#T) ≤ (sup|Df|)ⁿ M(T) (Ch. 6, 2.29, chapter-06.txt lines 503–507).
Notation. H := μHE[n] and ν := H⌞M (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier). Put h(x) := θ(x)·g(x) ∈ ℝ, with θ(x) cast to ℝ. For r ∈ ℝ, ‖r‖ₑ := ofReal|r| ∈ [0, ∞]. By definition ∫_M θg dH = ∫ h dν and R.measure = ν.withDensity θ, with θ cast to [0, ∞].
1. Measurability of the weight. x ↦ (θ(x) : [0, ∞]) is measurable. It is the composition of the measurable θ : ℝ^P → ℕ (R.measurable_mult) with a map out of ℕ, and every map on ℕ is measurable (measurable_from_nat).
2. From the integral to its modulus. ofReal(∫ h dν) ≤ ofReal|∫ h dν| = ‖∫ h dν‖ₑ, since r ≤ |r| and ofReal is monotone.
3. Modulus of the integral. ‖∫ h dν‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ ‖h(x)‖ₑ dν(x) (Mathlib enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm). This holds for every function h: if h is not ν-integrable, its Bochner integral is 0.
4. Pointwise domination. For ν-a.e. x, ‖h(x)‖ₑ ≤ 1_G(x)·(ofReal(c)·θ(x)). Take x in the ν-conull set where |g(x)| ≤ 1_G(x)·c.
 (a) If x ∈ G, then |g(x)| ≤ c. Since θ(x) ≥ 0, |θ(x)g(x)| = θ(x)|g(x)|. Hence ‖h(x)‖ₑ = ofReal(θ(x)·|g(x)|) ≤ ofReal(θ(x)·c), as ofReal is monotone. Since θ(x) ≥ 0, ofReal(θ(x)·c) = ofReal(θ(x))·ofReal(c), and ofReal of a natural number is that number, so this equals θ(x)·ofReal(c) = 1_G(x)·(ofReal(c)·θ(x)).
 (b) If x ∉ G, then |g(x)| ≤ 0, so g(x) = 0 and h(x) = 0. Hence ‖h(x)‖ₑ = 0 = 1_G(x)·(ofReal(c)·θ(x)).
5. Integration of the bound. By step 4 and a.e. monotonicity of the lower integral,
∫⁻ ‖h‖ₑ dν ≤ ∫⁻ 1_G·(ofReal(c)·θ) dν = ∫⁻_G ofReal(c)·θ dν = ofReal(c)·∫⁻_G θ dν = ofReal(c)·(ν.withDensity θ)(G) = ofReal(c)·R.measure G.
The equalities use, in order: G measurable (Mathlib lintegral_indicator); θ measurable by step 1 (Mathlib lintegral_const_mul); G measurable (Mathlib withDensity_apply); and the definition of R.measure.
6. Conclusion. Chaining steps 2, 3 and 5 gives ofReal(∫_M θ(x)g(x) dHⁿ(x)) = ofReal(∫ h dν) ≤ ofReal(c)·R.measure G. No finiteness of R.measure G and no sign condition on c is needed. ∎

The script below was checked with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` in namespace GMT.Ch07 with the contract's opens, as the body of `theorem Submission.dor_lmb_pc_cm_ofReal_integral_le_measure : <frozen type> := by`; no sibling is used. #print axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
```lean
  intro P n U G R g c hG hg
  have hθ : Measurable fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) := measurable_from_nat.comp R.measurable_mult
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * g x ∂μHE[n])
      ≤ ‖∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * g x ∂μHE[n]‖ₑ := by
        rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_abs_self _)
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in R.carrier, ‖(R.mult x : ℝ) * g x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] := enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in R.carrier, G.indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal c * (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞)) x
          ∂μHE[n] := by
        refine lintegral_mono_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [hg] with x hx
        by_cases hxG : x ∈ G
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxG] at hx ⊢
          rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
          calc ENNReal.ofReal ((R.mult x : ℝ) * |g x|) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((R.mult x : ℝ) * c) :=
                ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
            _ = ENNReal.ofReal c * (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) := by
                rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, mul_comm]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxG] at hx ⊢
          have : g x = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp hx
          simp [this]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c * R.measure G := by
        rw [lintegral_indicator hG, lintegral_const_mul _ hθ, IMRep.measure,
          withDensity_apply _ hG]
```
